# Big Millennium News Is Coming to SC'26: Visit Us at Booth 6310


3 Nov 2026


• 1 minute read


-
-
-
-


*Accelerating engineering from semiconductors to AI factories*


AI is transforming engineering. From advanced semiconductors and high-speed interconnects to AI factories and digital twins, design complexity, simulation scale, and performance demands have never been higher. At SC'26 in Chicago, November 16 – 19, Cadence will show how accelerated computing, physics-based simulation, IP, agentic AI, and digital twin technology come together to help you design, optimize, and operate the next generation of intelligent systems.


## Important Millennium News Is on the Way


Built on the Cadence Millennium M2000 AI Supercomputer and powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell platform, our solutions help engineers solve problems that were previously impractical or impossible. **At SC'26, we will announce important news about Millennium accelerated computing: an expansion of the applications supported by the Millennium M2000 AI Supercomputer.** We'll share the full details on release day, but if you care about getting from weeks of waiting to days of progress, you'll want to hear it first.


The best way to learn more is to **visit our booth.** Our team will be on hand to walk you through the latest Millennium news and show you what it means for your designs.


## What to See at Booth 6310


Stop by for live demonstrations and conversations with our experts:


- **Cadence Millennium M2000 AI Supercomputer:** Powering GPU-accelerated design, simulation, and AI workloads
- **Cadence UALink IP:** Scaling fabrics for AI factories
- **Cadence HBM4E PHY @ 16Gbps:** The fastest HBM4E for AI factories
- **Cadence Reality Digital Twin Platform:** Design, simulation, optimization, and operation of AI factories and data centers across power, cooling, networking, and workload infrastructure


## Meet with Our Experts


Whether you're designing AI silicon, advanced packaging, next-generation interconnects, or large-scale AI infrastructure, we can help you accelerate innovation from concept to deployment. Visit booth 6310 or schedule a meeting with our experts at SC'26. Our booth will also be open during the SC'26 Gala.


## See You at SC'26


Be among the first to hear what's next for Millennium accelerated computing.[Read the event page and plan your visit to booth 6310.](https://events.cadence.com/M3AmdK?RefId=blog)
